% ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Styles and colors
% ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

% Required TikZ libraries for non-circular point shapes:
% \usetikzlibrary{shapes.geometric,shapes.symbols}

\definecolor{stzPointreviewnegativeregularpolygonFill}{HTML}{000000}
\definecolor{stzPointreviewnegativeregularpolygonStroke}{HTML}{000000}
\definecolor{stzPointreviewnegativeregularpolygonText}{HTML}{000000}
\pgfdeclarelayer{stratifiedLayer0}
\pgfsetlayers{stratifiedLayer0,main}

\begin{tikzpicture}[
    line cap=round,
    line join=round
]

    % ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    % Coordinates
    % ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    \coordinate (pointPoint0p0) at (1,2);

    % ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    % Layered drawing commands
    % ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    % Layer 0: stratifiedLayer0
    \begin{pgfonlayer}{stratifiedLayer0}
        %----------------------------------------
        % Codimension 2 strata: points
        %----------------------------------------
        \node[
            regular polygon,
            fill=stzPointreviewnegativeregularpolygonFill,
            draw=stzPointreviewnegativeregularpolygonStroke,
            text=stzPointreviewnegativeregularpolygonText,
            fill opacity=1,
            draw opacity=1,
            text opacity=1,
            line width=0.4pt,
            solid,
            dash phase=0pt,
            line cap=butt,
            line join=miter,
            inner sep=1.5pt,
            inner xsep=-30pt,
            inner ysep=-30pt,
            outer xsep=3pt,
            outer ysep=3pt,
            minimum width=-20pt,
            minimum height=-20pt,
            anchor=corner 1
        ] at (pointPoint0p0) {};

    \end{pgfonlayer}

    % Codimension 0 strata: regions
    % Codimension 1 strata: curves
    % Labels

\end{tikzpicture}
